name: Palming Eye Exercise
description: Rest tired eyes by covering them gently with warmed palms.

slides.description: Rub your palms together until warm.
Close your eyes and cover them gently with your palms.
Breathe slowly and relax your shoulders.

name: Neck Stretches
description: Release neck and upper-shoulder tension from screen posture.

slides.description: Tilt your head gently to the right, hold.
Tilt your head gently to the left, hold.
Slowly roll your head forward and back.

name: Stand & Walk
description: Get the blood flowing with a short walk away from your desk.

slides.description: Stand up slowly and stretch your arms overhead.
Walk around for a minute if you can.

name: Shoulder Rolls
description: Loosen tight shoulders with slow rolling motions.

name: Chest Opener
description: Open your chest and reverse the forward hunch of desk posture.

slides.subText: Sit up straight on the front edge of your chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Reach behind your back and interlace your fingers together or hold the lower back of your chair.
Roll your shoulders backward and gently lift your chest toward the ceiling until you feel a pull.
Hold this open position steady while taking deep, slow breaths.
Release your hands slowly and return your body to the starting upright posture.
